hypothesis: Retention on pg.public.orders deleted change records before order-sync read them: its committed offset sits just above the log start, so those changes were lost and never reached analytics.orders.

verdict.reason: The hypothesis says Kafka retention deleted the change records before order-sync read them, and that those changes were lost and never reached the warehouse. That matches the root cause and puts it in the kafka layer, and it does not tell the reset-to-latest story.
